SHA-256: 14332d2b292a59e07d2cd3f86bf7e3baa4774a39fcc6ab36c0cba41532657ac3

Source reference: https://github.com/evanw/glfx.js/tree/86ae72acfffcd50774507eb7b69887ba2493dc35
Documentation: https://evanw.github.io/glfx.js/docs/

HACHITU uses the actual upstream WebGL filters and Unsharp Mask. Only the
UI, parameter recipes, lifecycle and existing render/export integration are
application code. No custom effect shaders or AI image API are used.
The script loads lazily from this website. Photo pixels never leave the browser.
